title: This is Not Flannel, it’s a slippery type of fleece.
text:
This is Not Flannel, it’s a slippery type of fleece.. Nice large size Warming blanket.
Shuts off after 4 hours,I think it should shut off after 6 or 8 hours.
Has 5 different heating choices.
The color gray is kind of dark, but a nice color.
This was advertised as Flannel, and don’t be confused when you order this, as
It is fleece !
With the wires in it, it slides all over, and off of you.
I’m not a fan of this type of fleece.

I gave this a two star for advertising Flannel, as that is why I ordered this. And it’s fleece!
